name: Tamagawa Mayumi
source:
Long dark hair, cool and rarely smiles.

She has excellent grades and good conduct. She is trusted by teachers and students alike.

Many boys have asked her for a relationship because of her beauty, but they have all been turned down.

She is the head of the biology club and loves UMAs.

[spoiler] She has a preference for older men but the protagonist is slowly becoming someone dear to her. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/futariha.html]official site[/url]]
